disk.space.description: Shown when the target folder has too little free space. {size} and {free} are file sizes.

stems.failed.description: Reason when writing the stems failed.

stems.noSound.description: Reason when no stem had sound.

timeline.invalid.description: Reason when main refused a timeline plan.

timeline.media.description: Reason when the media disagree with the plan.

timeline.cancelled.description: Done view line when Cancel export was clicked while the timeline was written. The video is saved; the timeline is not.

presetFile.notSaved.description: Reason when a preset file could not be written.

feature.notReady.description: Shown if a setting of this release is used before its part is built (development only).

cancelled.description: Why a download, a request or a job stopped: the user cancelled it. The renderer compares a message with this text to tell a cancel from a failure, so it is one message for every process.

localAi.unknownModel.description: AI on this PC: a request named a model Flown does not know.

localAi.busy.description: AI on this PC: only one model downloads at a time.

localAi.unknownChoice.description: AI on this PC: the model choice sent was neither Automatic nor a model.

localAi.notDownloaded.description: AI on this PC: the model picked for use is not on this PC.
